boundary: Host Node Three.js geometry in authored bind pose before merging/skinning. Original source read-only and only in-memory helper exports/metadata. Physical units include each actor root scale. No WebGL pixels, texture image generation, shader output or device performance.
method: World-space triangle tangent Jacobian of UV times the existing 64x64 repeat(4,4) bump/roughness tile. Singular values give principal texels/m; area-weighted quantiles use geometric triangle area. UV sign alone is not classified as a defect: a whole chart may be consistently mirrored. No global UV-overlap test is performed because separate pieces intentionally share tile coordinates.

sessionClosure.scope: Based on this reviewer tool/session completion records only; does not diagnose other writers or file reappearance.
